thread:
jenna: Hey everyone — Acme started seeing rerank errors right after the 14:00 deploy. Some requests get 410 model_gone, and a few succeed with all scores 0.0.

liz: Thanks. Can you paste the exact curl, the model id they sent, and any request_id header?

jenna: Curl + sample response:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ACME" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rerank-2024-v1",
    "queries": ["best widget"],
    "documents": [["doc A","doc B"]]
  }'
```

HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
{
  "error": "model_deprecated",
  "message": "model rerank-2024-v1 was retired 2026-03-15",
  "request_id": "req_ZZ001"
}

jenna: Also saw requests where HTTP/200 returned scores [0.0, 0.0] at the same time window.

alex: Looking at routing for req_ZZ001: model_lookup returned RETIRED for rerank-2024-v1 and we responded 410. That explains the Gone. The all-zero results are from an ugly edge: some requests hit an older compatibility shim that returns zeros when the KV cache or weights are missing.

maya: Infra note: an alias-prune job ran overnight and removed alias "rerank-2024" -> "rerank-stable" mappings. We intended a staged cleanup but a maintenance flag was flipped to aggressive pruning. That removed the redirect that would normally handle pinned ids.

liz: Immediate mitigation options: (1) re-create a short-lived alias rerank-2024 -> rerank-stable so pinned clients recover; (2) add a guard to the prune job to check active tenant references; (3) give customers a one-line restart/cache-clear snippet.

jenna: Can you add the alias? We restarted Acme's service after you added it earlier and they back to normal.

alex: Created ENG-6601 to add a pre-check (query active tenant refs) + metric alert when retired model is still in use. I'll add logging for any requests referencing RETIRED ids.

maya: Alias created via admin: 
```
> alias get rerank-2024
alias: rerank-2024 -> rerank-stable (target=rerank-stable-v3) expires=2026-03-17T15:10:00Z
```
TTL=45m. Confirmed propagation to router nodes.

jenna: After alias + tenant restart, Acme reports 200 with meaningful scores again. Thanks :tada:

liz: Closing immediate support escalation. Follow-ups: customer comms explaining deprecation timeline + recommended alias usage, docs update to dissuade pinning model variant ids, and track ENG-6601 until guard is in prod.

ops-bot: incident logged INC-2026-233 rerank-alias-prune-regression severity=low
